text:
maria: heads-up - master CI just flipped red on a flaky unit in runtime: kv_serde_fuzz_test. only repros on linux-arm64 in the nightly matrix. failing assertion is a deserial mismatch. anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
ci-bot: [CI] job failed: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/4123 (kv_serde_fuzz_test) - build 1789 - log attached
alex: saw a couple of flakes last week but dismissed as infra noise. can you paste the failing diff / seed?
maria: here's the failing snippet from the log:```
E assertion failed: expected {
  key: "session_id",
  value: "abc123"
} but got {
  key: "session_id",
  value: "ab c123"
}
seed=204827
stack: runtime::kv::deserialize::v1 at serde.rs:134
```
jamie: weird, looks like a byte-level corruption during serde. could be alignment/endianness on arm? did the test use any unsafe code paths?
maria: no unsafe in the test, but runtime serialization uses the compact encoder (quantized layout). only arm nodes affected so far.
linus: I'll kick off a targeted rerun on the arm runner with the same seed. @ci-bot can you trigger a rerun?
ci-bot: @linus rerun requested: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/4123/1789/retry - queued on arm-runner-3 :white_check_mark:
priya: if it repros consistently with the seed we can try narrowing the commit range. otherwise bisecting may help. I can help with a bisect if needed.
alex: also check whether LTO or cross-compile flags differ for that runner. we've had stray flags cause struct padding differences before.
maria: good call. runners show CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO = true on arm-runner-3, false on x86. adding that to hypothesis.
linus: rerun finished: still failed on arm-runner-3 with same seed. attaching job log id 1790.
maria: thanks. @jamie can you take a quick look at the serializer impl? maybe a race in the buffer write logic that only surfaces with different instruction ordering on arm.
jamie: on it. will grep for unsized writes and any mem::transmute usage. if I find something I'll post a tiny repro.
alex: tl;dr plan: (1) reproduce locally on an arm64 dev VM with seed 204827, (2) run under ASAN/MSAN if available, (3) if repro, bisect commit range to find regression, (4) if not repro, capture more logs and collect core.
priya: I'll schedule a short bisect window later today and can coordinate with infra for an arm VM.
maria: thanks all. posting estimated priority: P2 (blocking a nightly but not release). pinging infra privately for runner config audit. :thumbsup:
linus: assigning to myself for initial bisect prep. will post updates here.
maria: appreciated. adding test to flaky-tests board for tracking.
jamie: quick note - I found one suspicious write in compact encoder: `buf.extend_from_slice(&val_bytes);` where val_bytes comes from a scope that might get mutated in debug builds. investigating further.
alex: nice find. keep us posted.
priya: if you need another pair of eyes on a small patch, ping me and I'll review.
maria: closing loop for now — will update thread when bisect yields a culprit or infra change fixes it. :white_check_mark:
